fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on the upcoming election and a proposed $800,000 auditorium/convention hall bond issue, discussion of municipal welfare relief practices (grocery orders and the welfare board store), and commentary on Florida criminal justice and the pardoning board. Includes coverage touching on the Homestead bank situation and a local power company potentially being offered to Florida Power & Light Company, along with extensive local entertainment and nightlife listings (theaters, dance halls, clubs), sports items including boxing and a humorous preview of a football game, and numerous local advertisements.
